source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: When he has Boon of Death, Mortarion can activate it in the Fight phase. The option triggers when an attack targets a friendly unit with the DEATH GUARD keyword up to 6″ from him. Until the phase ends, check each melee casualty in that unit that had yet to fight. Roll 1D6 per casualty. On 2+, keep the model in place. It may fight after the enemy resolves its attacks. Then remove the model.

trigger.event: attack targets friendly DEATH GUARD unit

effect.eachRecipient: model in targeted friendly DEATH GUARD unit
effect.trigger: destroyed by melee attack before fighting
successEffect: fight after attacking unit finishes its attacks
